particularites.text: Structure actionnariale a classes multiples (A/B/C) concentrant environ 99% du pouvoir de vote entre les mains des co-fondateurs Evan Spiegel (CEO) et Bobby Murphy (CTO) pour une detention economique combinee d'environ 20% du capital total - lecture permanente de gouvernance d'entreprise, sans impact sur un calcul de l'application.

ownership.insiderDesc: Co-fondateurs Evan Spiegel (CEO) et Bobby Murphy (CTO), detenteurs quasi exclusifs des actions de Classe C (10 voix/action) leur conferant ensemble environ 99% du pouvoir de vote, pour une detention economique combinee estimee a environ 20% du capital total (classes A+B+C).
ownership.insiderSource: Rapport SEC 2026 (10-K/proxy), repris par BGR (3 aout 2026) - detention economique calculee a partir de la repartition par classe d'actions divulguee.
ownership.coverageNote: Aucun gerant de la watchlist Tier 1/2 identifie avec une position materielle et recente confirmee dans les derniers 13F disponibles (T1 2026). Coatue Management (Tier 1), historiquement actionnaire de Snap, n'apparait plus dans son top 10 13F au T1 2026 sans confirmation d'une sortie totale ou d'une position residuelle. Base d'actionnaires institutionnels dominee par des gerants passifs/indiciels (Vanguard, Fidelity/FMR, BlackRock, State Street, Capital World/International Investors) hors perimetre de la watchlist.

items.title: Le Nouveau-Mexique poursuit Snap pour manquement allegue a proteger les mineurs contre l'exploitation sexuelle en ligne (sextorsion).

Litige consolide (MDL n°3047, Californie du Nord) reunissant des milliers de plaignants (particuliers, districts scolaires, comtes) alleguant un design addictif de Snapchat nuisible a la sante mentale des mineurs ; premiers proces-temoins programmes devant la Cour superieure de Californie (comte de Los Angeles).
items.allegedBy: Plaignants multiples - class actions et poursuites individuelles consolidees
items.outcome: Snap a annonce un accord transactionnel partiel en amont du proces, le 9 fevrier 2026 ; conditions financieres non divulguees.

items.title: La Floride poursuit Snap pour violation alleguee de la loi HB 3 (acces des mineurs a la plateforme) et pratiques commerciales trompeuses (FDUTPA).
Le Texas poursuit Snap pour conception jugee addictive de l'application et defaut de protection des mineurs contre le contenu explicite.

La Commission europeenne ouvre une procedure formelle au titre du Digital Services Act (DSA) visant la conformite de Snap sur l'evaluation des risques systemiques et la protection des mineurs dans l'UE.

compliance.note: Aucune fraude financiere averee ni enquete SEC/DOJ identifiee a ce jour ; le registre porte essentiellement sur le contentieux reglementaire/civil lie a la protection des mineurs (design addictif, exploitation sexuelle, conformite DSA), tres repandu dans l'industrie des reseaux sociaux depuis 2024. Un accord transactionnel partiel a ete annonce en fevrier 2026 en amont d'un proces californien. (Recherche du 2026-08-04)

epsReported.note: GAAP diluted EPS of -$0.10 on a GAAP net loss of $164M (improved by $99M YoY from -$263M); non-GAAP EPS of $0.13 beat consensus by ~$0.07 per Seeking Alpha.

dernierCall.guidanceProchainTrimestre: Q3 26 revenue guided to $1.70-1.74B (+13% to +15% YoY vs $1.507B in Q3 25; deceleration vs +19% in Q2 reflects World Cup spend normalization and tougher comps after the ad platform stabilized in late Q2 25); adjusted EBITDA guided to $300-350M, with restructuring personnel savings more fully reflected from Q3 onward.
dernierCall.guidanceAnnuelle: FY26 infrastructure costs raised to $1.65-1.70B (from $1.60-1.65B) for incremental AI/ML capacity supporting revenue growth (framed as optional flexibility, not committed spend); other cost of revenue kept at 16-17% of revenue; FY adjusted opex ~$2.75B and SBC ~$1.05B; after the current buyback completes in Q4, a new multi-year dilution-management program funded primarily by FCF targets a stable fully diluted share count in 2027; management reiterates sustained positive GAAP net income beginning in 2027.
pointsCles: Q2 26 revenue of $1.60B (+19% YoY, ~ $66M above consensus): advertising +9% to $1.28B and other revenue +85% to $316M (Snapchat+, Memory Storage, Lens+; <3% of 971M MAUs are paying subscribers). Adjusted EBITDA of $250M (vs $41M a year ago), gross margin 58% (+7pts), FCF $121M — 8th consecutive positive-FCF quarter; free cash flow per share is now management's primary financial objective.

April 2026 restructuring (~1,000 roles, -16% of headcount, $128.5M of Q2 charges) already visible: total adjusted costs grew only +4% YoY against +19% revenue growth; AI-driven internal leverage (code commits per engineer +75%, AI reviewing 90% of pull requests, support ticket volume -62% since January).

Direct-response engine is driving the ad recovery: total conversions +56% YoY, cost per install -8%, cost per purchase -18%, app purchase volume +128%, dynamic product ads revenue +43%; sponsored Snaps reach ~1/3 incremental; World Cup brand spend helped Q2 and normalizes in Q3 (guide implies +13-15% growth vs +19% delivered).

Specs commercial launch this fall (September 16 LA event, $2,195 price point, pre-orders open ~7 weeks): investment kept inside the existing opex envelope and paced on product/ecosystem/economic milestones; mass-market adoption not expected before end of decade; no comment on a Specs spin-off; several US trials and youth-safety regulatory scrutiny flagged for H2 2026.

hypothese.text:
== THESIS SUMMARY ==
A measurable operating turnaround: Q2 26 showed revenue +19% against adjusted costs +4%, the direct result of the April 2026 restructuring (~1,000 roles, >500M annualized savings targeted in H2). The bet is NOT a miraculous ad acceleration (already solid via AI tools - Smart Campaigns, conversions +56%) but the cost discipline converting existing growth into a first full year of positive net income in 2027. Infrastructure-cost guidance was still RAISED (1.65-1.70bn) - the AI compute bill grows even under discipline.

== THESIS READ ==
- The 2026 -> 2027 sign flip (EPS -0.09 -> +0.18) is the entire thesis; every quarter of cost discipline is evidence. Watch: H2 opex prints vs the >500M savings target.
- Restructuring is treated as a RECURRING cost in disguise (quasi-annual since IPO: 2019 legal, 2022, 2026) - deliberately NOT retreated; the model is honest about it. Watch: whether 2027 passes without another one.
- Infrastructure inflation is the counterweight: raised guidance shows AI compute eats savings. Watch: infra cost per DAU trajectory.

== SPECIAL FACTORS ==
Base = published GAAP, restructuring kept in (ancrage restructuration_recurrente). Financial result: recent near-zero quarterly rhythm retained over the normative Treasury formula (low-coupon convertibles - ancrage fin_result_snap). Tax: low effective rising gradually (NOL carryforwards), 10% -> 16% across the plan. Loss-year bridge documented.

== PARAMETERS & WATCH-LIST ==
2026: revenue 6,818M (+15%), EBIT -140M (last loss year modeled), EPS -0.09; 2027-2030: revenue +11-14%/yr, EBIT margin 4% -> 10.5%, shares -1.2%/yr. Watch: DAU/engagement stability through the cost cuts; ad-pricing recovery; NOL utilization pace as profits arrive.

== CATALYSTS ==
Q3 (Oct) - first full savings quarter; 2027 profitability inflection; Smart Campaign adoption metrics; any restructuring recurrence (negative).

ancrages.moteur: Reprise de la croissance publicitaire portee par les outils IA (Smart Campaign, conversions +56%) et montee en puissance du revenu Other (Snapchat+, Lens+, Memories) qui pese desormais 20% du CA et croit a 85%
Ralentissement progressif attendu de la croissance publicitaire a mesure que la base de comparaison grossit, Specs devenant le principal catalyseur incrementiel non chiffre au-dela de 2027

Restructuration d'avril 2026 (plus de 500 M$ d'economies annualisees, pleinement reflechies a partir du T3 26 donc en base pleine des 2027) et effet de levier operationnel deja observe (CA +19% vs couts ajustes +4% au T2 26)

Les charges de restructuration (2019 : 100 M$ ; 2022 : 189 M$ ; 2026 : 128,5 M$ au 1S) survenant a intervalles reguliers depuis l'IPO sont traitees comme une composante recurrente-deguisee du cout operationnel, non retraitee dans data ni exclue des adjXXX

Charges/produits financiers projetes sur la base du rythme net trimestriel recent (quasi a l'equilibre, obligations convertibles a coupon tres faible 0-0,75% emises 2019-2023) plutot que la regle normative Treasury 10 ans +2pts
Taux d'IS effectif maintenu bas et croissant progressivement du fait des importants deficits reportables (NOL) accumules depuis l'introduction en bourse en 2017
Nouveau programme pluriannuel de gestion de la dilution finance par le free cash flow a partir de 2027, apres achevement du programme de rachat actuel au T4 2026
